effect: The fragments gathered into a separate rubble world, completing the remaining goal while leaving other fragments in the reservoir.
reaction: The contrast between disruption and gentle reassembly was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Forming a moon around the same world followed through its impacts gave the sequence a satisfying payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding metal-rich fragments felt less compelling than the impacts, although the explanation of core formation was clear.

surprise.text: The initial rocky bodies formed through concentration and gravitational collapse, not simply by grains sticking together.

arbitrary.text: The metal-rich fragments' precise role was not obvious before combining them with the molten world, though the result explained it.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the contrasting futures of the moon-bearing world and the remaining fragments, though the offered combinations made the choices fairly directed.
